label: Atemporal cause-in-esse versus an existing world-local causal predecessor
term: atemporal cause-in-esse versus an existing world-local causal predecessor
resolution: The q.3 CausesIn c x esse reading does not by its type supply world-indexed existence of c or a world-local Ontic.Causes edge. The two open interfaces state these separately. Sourcehood only excludes incoming edges from actual nodes; an absent candidate therefore cannot contradict sourcehood. Composite is the existing q.3 predicate, not the proper-part proxy in PowerExistenceBoundary. Neither interface is attributed to Aquinas, and no cause of becoming, temporal first cause, intrinsic reason, God identification or maximality is inferred.
